content.text:
I fixed the about page on phones. It was stretching to 620px on a 390px screen, so you had to scroll sideways.

**Cause:** a leftover rule at the very end of `site/css/pages.css` set `.story { grid-template-columns: 1fr 480px; }`. It came after the phone-size media query, so it overrode the single-column layout. The 480px workshop image column forced the page wider than the screen.

**Fix:** I deleted that rule. The visual tests (desktop and phone, all six pages) and the functional tests now pass, 28 in total. The phone screenshot for the about page matches the approved one again.

I couldn't tell which change introduced the stray rule, because the repo has only one commit.

STATUS: DONE
